description.text:
Gym Challenge (ジム☆チャレンジ) was the tournament of Japan's Official Pokémon Card Gyms (ポケモンカードジムオフィシャル), game and hobby shops that hosted the card game's local official play from October 2000, much like the Pokémon League abroad. From 2003 the gyms gave out promos of their own, mostly at the Gym Challenge: every player got foil-stamped basic Energy cards, told apart by their copyright year, and the winners special cards. From 2005 to 2007 it was a store representative match: each shop's winner, from 2007 its top two, got a silver Victory Medal, the first Victory Medal cards, and a place in that year's Gym Final.

From 2008 the gyms held a Gym Challenge to launch each new expansion, with a card for every player and others for the top finishers, often carrying the expansion's logo. In 2009 the stamped Energies gave way to holo basic Energy cards with promo numbers, 022 to 029/DPt-P and then 011 to 018/L-P, and from November 2009 gold, silver and bronze Victory Medals showing Pikachu went to each tournament's top three. In 2010 the gyms held launch tournaments for Reviving Legends, Lost Link and Clash at the Summit, the last LEGEND expansion. In August 2009 and 2010 the shops also ran a Summer Vacation Battle Campaign.
